title: Workforce housing fee waivers and repayment bill
summary: Bill 130, which would make developers repay fee waivers when affordable homes sell in higher price tiers, was moved on first reading on September 29, though no vote is in the meeting video. Its sponsor said the original waivers were rushed through before the budget and that a developer that had flipped homes out of affordability came back asking for money. In April, members added the earlier waivers to the budget's rates and fees.
